question: Amrit diwan cup is associated with _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Badminton**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Amrit Diwan Cup is **associated with the sport of Badminton**.
 
• Badminton is a racquet sport played using **racquets to hit a shuttlecock across a net**.
 
• The sport can be played in **singles (one player per side) and doubles (two players per side)** formats.
 
• Badminton has been a **part of the Summer Olympic Games since 1992**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton**

 
 
• Badminton is governed by the Badminton World Federation (BWF).
 
• The game is played on a rectangular court divided by a net, with players scoring points by striking the shuttlecock with their racquet so that it passes over the net and lands in the opponent's half of the court.
 
• Matches are typically played to the best of three games, with each game played to 21 points.
 
• Major tournaments include the All England Open Badminton Championships, the Thomas Cup, the Uber Cup, and the BWF World Championships.
 
 
 
• **Hockey**
 
 
• Hockey is a sport in which two teams play against each other by trying to maneuver a ball or a puck into the opponent's goal using a hockey stick.
 
• Field hockey is played on grass or artificial turf with a small, hard ball.
 
• Ice hockey is played on an ice rink with a puck.
 
• Major international competitions include the Olympic Games, the Hockey World Cup, and the Champions Trophy.
 
 
 
• **Basketball**
 
 
• Basketball is a team sport where two teams, usually of five players each, oppose each other on a rectangular court, competing with the primary objective of shooting a basketball through the opponent's hoop.
 
• The game was invented by Dr. James Naismith in 1891.
 
• Major competitions include the NBA, the FIBA World Cup, and the Olympic Games.
 
• Basketball is governed by the International Basketball Federation (FIBA).
 
 
 
• **Boat Race**
 
 
• Boat racing encompasses various types of races involving boats, including rowing, sailing, and powerboat racing.
 
• One of the most famous boat races is the annual Oxford and Cambridge Boat Race held on the River Thames in London.
 
• Other notable boat races include the America's Cup, the Henley Royal Regatta, and the Sydney to Hobart Yacht Race.
 
• The International Rowing Federation (FISA) governs the sport of rowing.
